head.t: Johnson & Johnson launches Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary IVL catheter in the USA
head.x: Johnson & Johnson has announced the US launch of its Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) catheter, designed to treat a broad range of calcified coronary artery lesions.
